meta.title: dsh-pipeline
meta.description: Multi-node workflow orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: define agent pipelines as JSON, compile them into native workflow-engine scripts, and run them with one command.

errors.schema.mustBeObject: definition must be a JSON object
errors.schema.labelNonEmpty: node "label" must be a non-empty string
errors.schema.promptsNonEmpty: node "prompts" must be a non-empty array of strings
errors.schema.promptNonEmpty: prompt must be a non-empty string
errors.schema.modelFieldNonEmpty: node "model.%field%" must be a non-empty string
errors.schema.skillsInvalid: node "skills" must be a non-empty array of non-empty strings
errors.schema.toolsMustBeObject: node "tools" must be an object with allow/deny arrays
errors.schema.toolsFieldInvalid: node "tools.%field%" must be a non-empty array of non-empty strings
errors.schema.toolsAllowOrDeny: node "tools" must declare at least one of allow/deny
errors.schema.dependsOnInvalid: node "dependsOn" must be an array of node-id strings
errors.schema.outputSchemaObject: node "outputSchema" must be an object-rooted JSON schema
errors.schema.retryInvalid: node "retry" must be a non-negative integer
errors.ir.duplicateId: duplicate node id "%id%" (definitions must be unique)
errors.ir.reservedId: node id "%id%" is reserved (used as a template variable); pick another id
errors.ir.malformedTemplate: %location%: malformed template expression at offset %offset% — expected "{{variable}}"; variables are "input", "prev", or a node id
errors.ir.prevFirstPrompt: %location%: {{prev}} has no previous output — it is the node's first prompt
errors.ir.selfReference: %location%: node "%id%" references its own final output; use {{prev}} for an earlier prompt's output within the same node
errors.ir.unknownVariable: %location%: template variable "{{%variable%}}" does not match any node id (available: %available%, "input", "prev")
errors.ir.skipReference: %location%: template variable "{{%variable%}}" references a node with failure policy "skip" — a skipped node's output is null, so consuming it is a value error. Use dependsOn for ordering only, or change that node's policy to "abort".
errors.ir.unknownDependency: node "%id%" depends on "%dep%", which is not a node in this pipeline (available: %available%)
errors.ir.dependencyCycle: dependency cycle among nodes: %stuck% (cycles cannot be executed)
errors.ir.outputSchemaSubset: node "%id%": outputSchema is outside the engine's supported object-rooted subset — %detail%
errors.ir.gateMaxAgentsPerNode: %where%: "options.maxAgentsPerNode" — the run ceiling is engine-owned and per-node limits have no seam on dsh 0.1.5-rc.1
errors.ir.gateTools: %where%: per-node "tools" routing — the workflow engine's agent() accepts only label/phase/schema/provider/model and has no toolFilter path on dsh 0.1.5-rc.1; remove it rather than have it silently dropped
errors.ir.gateReasoningEffort: %where%: "model.reasoningEffort" routing — the engine forwards only provider/model on dsh 0.1.5-rc.1
errors.runner.engineRejected: workflow engine rejected the run of pipeline "%name%": %detail%
errors.runner.capsAgentOptions: subagent provider "%provider%" does not support agentOptions, but these nodes route their own provider/model: %nodes%. Remove their "model" overrides to run on the parent's route, or use an in-process provider (spawn/fork).
errors.runner.capsOutputSchema: subagent provider "%provider%" does not support outputSchema, but these nodes declare one: %nodes%. Remove their "outputSchema" to run, or use an in-process provider (spawn/fork).
errors.runner.skillsRegistryMissing: no skills registry is available in this session (ctx.skills is unregistered), but these nodes declare "skills": %nodes%. Remove their "skills" fields, or enable a skill provider (e.g. skill-filesystem).
errors.runner.skillResolveFailed: node "%node%" declares skill "%skill%", but resolving it failed: %detail%
errors.runner.skillNotFound: node "%node%" declares skill "%skill%", but no skill provider serves it — check the name (skills must be discoverable by a provider such as skill-filesystem).
errors.runner.skillMalformed: node "%node%" declares skill "%skill%", but the resolved skill is malformed: %detail%
errors.store.refusingSave:
refusing to save an invalid definition:
%items%
errors.store.invalidName: "%name%" is not a valid pipeline name (letters, digits, "_" and "-"; must start alphanumeric)
errors.entry.noProvider: no subagent provider registered as "%provider%"%available% - check the dsh-pipeline provider setting
errors.entry.toolRequiresAgent: pipeline tool requires a calling agent (exec.agent was undefined)
